pattern: blocks\ ordinary\ queued\ runs\ without\ cancelling\ them$

name: triage-sqlite-upgrade-03
case: blocks ordinary waiting runs without cancelling them
pattern: blocks\ ordinary\ waiting\ runs\ without\ cancelling\ them$

name: triage-sqlite-upgrade-04
